items.current_score_impact: Architect score 8; blocking issue prevents pass
items.title: Reconcile P043 reference contract with GraphQL-only P031 correction
items.description: Amend P043 reference and composed P031 gate language so command-completion refresh, command receipt display, and MCP command-control rules are explicitly outside P031-owned UI. Keep MCP documented for non-UI surfaces only.
items.estimated_lift: Resolving removes the only blocker. Expected architect score lift: +0.5 to +1.0.
items.acceptance_criterion: P043/P031 reference docs state P031 UI consumes GraphQL reads only. proposal-031 gate fails on UI MCP, UI GraphQL mutations, and UI command receipt state.

items.current_score_impact: Converges with UX-R9-01, UI-02, PO-R9-04 across all four reviewers
items.title: Define binary approval disabled-state contract
items.description: Make approval decision behavior binary: hidden/read-only diagnostics only, or enabled through a named separately approved transport. No Swift inference of write availability. Replace disabled primary buttons with a distinct diagnostic-only UI element.
items.estimated_lift: Expected architect: +0.2, UX: +0.5, UI: +0.3, PO: +0.1. Highest cross-panel impact.
items.acceptance_criterion: Absent an approved transport, approval controls are disabled/hidden with server-provided diagnostic reasons. Gate proves controls cannot call MCP, GraphQL mutation, or local mutation.

items.title: Map new read-only metadata to concrete GraphQL schema fields
items.description: Add a schema matrix for disabledReasonCode, payloadAvailabilityState, payloadUnavailableReasonCode, writePathState, diagnosticId, and serverDebugDetail: GraphQL type, enum cases, nullability, redaction, Swift presenter, and tests.
items.estimated_lift: Expected architect score lift: +0.3. Also resolves UI-03 indirectly.
items.acceptance_criterion: Approval, report, and disabled-state metadata fields are mapped to concrete GraphQL types with redaction tests.

items.title: Define P031-owned UI file/module boundary inventory
items.description: Enumerate the exact Swift files/types in P031 scope, legacy-only files, generated GraphQL operation locations, forbidden import/call patterns, and explicit exclusions for non-workflow support.
items.acceptance_criterion: P031 gate has a maintained file/type allowlist. Static checks fail for governed surfaces importing MCP, GraphQL mutations, or local mutation services.

items.current_score_impact: Product owner score 8; condition for full approval
items.title: Document operator write-path workflow before dogfood
items.description: Map each removed P031 UI write control to its current alternative surface (MCP terminal, CLI, automation) or explicitly mark it temporarily unavailable with a follow-up reference.
items.estimated_lift: Expected product owner score lift: +0.5. Resolves one of two PO approval conditions.
items.acceptance_criterion: Pre-dogfood operator communication artifact maps 100% of removed controls. Zero dogfood-blocking escalations from undocumented write paths.

items.current_score_impact: Product owner score 8; condition for full approval
items.title: Add user-outcome metric for operator workflow viability
items.description: After each dogfood run, capture whether the participating operator completed the run workflow end-to-end without improvised workarounds.
items.estimated_lift: Expected product owner score lift: +0.25. Resolves second PO approval condition.
items.acceptance_criterion: Dogfood evidence includes per-run operator workflow-completion note from at least one operator.

items.title: Replace disabled approval buttons with contextual diagnostic guidance
items.description: Instead of a disabled standard button, use a distinct inline banner or terminal-styled text box with 'Execute via CLI' and copyable ID. Aligns operator mental model immediately.
items.acceptance_criterion: Approval controls when disabled use a diagnostic-specific UI element, not a disabled primary button.

items.title: Add first-run onboarding banner for the read-only transition
items.description: Display a dismissible banner on RunsHome during dogfood explaining that all control actions are managed via external tools.
items.acceptance_criterion: Dogfood mode shows a dismissible orientation banner on first thin-read launch.

items.title: Define Syncing pattern placement for detail views
items.description: Standardize Syncing placement for RunDetailView and ArtifactsView (e.g., top trailing edge of navigation bar or fixed header slot).
items.acceptance_criterion: Syncing placement is specified for all non-list contexts with no layout shift.

items.title: Specify exact icon family for Report payload availability indicators
items.description: Define SF Symbols or icon family for report payload states (e.g., doc.text.fill for available, doc for metadata-only) with stable width and density rules.
items.acceptance_criterion: Reports list payload indicator uses named SF Symbols with defined stable width.

items.title: Promote full r9 contract to checked-in proposal or add governing addendum
items.description: Synchronize r9 into docs/proposals/ or add a short addendum marking the run-local artifact as governing with Phase 0 obligations copied.
items.acceptance_criterion: Implementation tickets link one governing artifact. Checked-in proposal includes r9 no-UI-write guard strategy.

items.title: Add priority tiers and timeline expectations for follow-up proposals
items.description: Each follow-up should have a priority tier and expected start timeframe relative to P031 completion. P031-FOLLOWUP-APPROVAL-WRITE-PATH should be the immediate next proposal.
items.acceptance_criterion: Each follow-up has priority tier and expected start timeframe.
